thread:
maya: Heads up — noticed a regression on console canary: charts take ~3s longer on first paint after the last telemetry rollout. Repro on EU canary only.

sam: thanks for flagging. which page? heatmap or metrics explorer?

maya: metrics explorer, large time ranges (7d+). heatmap looks fine.

leo: is this the canary that added the telemetry-sampler change yesterday? @devx-bot what was the deploy id? :eyes:

devx-bot: deploy maya/telemetry-sampler-rollout v1.4.0 -> canary (eu) at 2025-10-12T09:14:22Z

karim: timeline: after that rollout we saw an increase in client parse time in Sentry, but it was marginal. now main-thread LCP jumps on open.

sam: can you paste a flame from chrome? quick check: is bundle size changed or a new sync import?

maya: attaching small snippet from perf timeline: 
```
Main thread: 0.0 - 0.5s: parse index.js (120ms)
0.5 - 1.0s: idle
1.0 - 3.8s: large V8 parse and compile for telemetry-client (1.2MB) + heatmap init
3.8 - 4.2s: first chart paint
```

leo: telemetry-client shows up as big chunk parse. we moved a sampling util earlier from a lazy worker into the main bundle in the rollup to avoid double-init races. that might be the cause.

karim: oh right, we inlined `sampler/priority.ts` into client to avoid message duplication. that likely added ~300KB to main.

sam: can we revert to dynamic import? iirc we had a lazy-worker fallback but it was racy with routing policy handshake.

maya: dynamic import helps but the cold path still fetches and parses. main issue is synchronous init doing config lookups and hitting `/internal/routing/affinity` which stalls until quota service responds.

leo: that's bad — frontend should never block paint on routing RPC. where is that call?

maya: in `telemetry-init.ts` we do `const cfg = await fetch('/internal/routing/affinity?route=metrics')` before we initialize sampler.

karim: Aha. If affinity endpoint is slow (we saw 500ms spikes on canary yesterday) that pauses everything. We need to asyncify init and fallback to default config.

sam: quick mitigation: change to `fetch(...).then(cfg => init(cfg)).catch(()=>init(defaultCfg))` and ensure sampler init is non-blocking. Can we patch canary?

devx-bot: deploy patch/maya/telemetry-nonblocking-init v1.4.1 -> canary (eu) queued by sam at 2025-10-12T10:02:10Z

maya: i'll prepare tiny PR. also propose: stop inlining sampler into main bundle — keep it in worker or lazy import and wrap in `requestIdleCallback`.

leo: agree. but we also need to revisit routing quotas — ops reported a thundering retry from clients when affinity timed out; that created a feedback loop.

karim: telemetry sampling logic currently retries affinity up to 3 times with exponential backoff, but it's synchronous so tens of clients cause bursts. we should cap retries and jitter.

sam: long-term plan: 1) non-blocking init + default config 2) move sampler to worker/lazy import 3) add circuit breaker around `/internal/routing/affinity` and fallback to region default 4) add telemetry gauge for client-side init latency.

maya: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/compare/.../telemetry-nonblocking-init (small diff). can we patch canary fast?

leo: rolling now. devx-bot shows deploy in progress.

devx-bot: deploy patch/maya/telemetry-nonblocking-init v1.4.1 -> canary (eu) succeeded at 2025-10-12T10:09:40Z

maya: canary looks much better in my local replay — LCP down ~1.8s. will monitor. :relieved:

karim:FYI i've opened an ops ticket to inspect affinity service logs at 09:00-10:00 window; might be a DB N+1 causing the latency.

sam: followup tasks: add unit test to ensure telemetry init never awaits network during page hydro; add e2e to fuzz affinity failover; and schedule a rollback plan for inlined imports if we see regressions after bundle trims.

leo: also flagging console telemetry dashboards — add a per-route client-init latency panel so we catch regressions earlier.

maya: thanks all. will keep thread updated.

sam: great catch, @maya. :thumbsup:

karim: noted for infra retro.

maya: last note — we should coordinate with product before changing default sampler behavior (sampling rates). i'll loop them in once the infra fix is stable.

sam: agreed. thanks everyone.
